dataContractFindings: Plotly hierarchy traces require EXACTLY ONE root; the Story 20.2 island is a 25-root FOREST and Plotly refuses it outright ('Multiple implied roots, cannot build sunburst hierarchy'). A project root must be synthesized.

The island's parent weight is NOT the sum of its emitted children (14 of 25 parents disagree; epic-1 is 42 vs 50) because an epic's weight counts stories while its children also include `aggregate` follow-up nodes. branchvalues:'total' is therefore invalid; leaf-only values with branchvalues:'remainder' is the honest mapping.
A single null in `values` silently collapses the ENTIRE hierarchy to one calcdata point and renders nothing — no error, no warning. Branch values must be 0.

Plotly resolves its own promises off an animation frame, so `await Plotly.react(...)` never settles in a non-compositing tab. The public `plotly_afterplot` event is the reliable reapply seam and is also the only one that fires for re-renders the component did not initiate.
